text: Sprint 1 plan: S1-DEM-01 Act 1 repo (8pt), S1-DEM-02 Act 2 macro-risk (8pt), S1-DEM-03 governance pack (13pt), all parallel with disjoint paths. Cross-ticket convention: Payment.card_number (full PAN, in-memory) and card_last4; full PAN literals only under demo/payments-ledger/tests/fixtures/; planted log line is logger.debug("settling payment %s card=%s amount=%s", payment.id, payment.card_number, payment.amount). Only S1-DEM-03 may run the claude CLI (cap $3). Dashboard, setup/reset scripts, RUNBOOK and sre-ops are Sprint 2.

S1-NAR-01 demo bridge: s10 (27 s) opens Act 1, s11 (13 s) closes governance, so Act 1 terminal = 273 s and governance terminal = 32 s inside 840 s. Fallback line: 'This morning's run, same prompt.' ADR-004 says 'two env vars' but docs list CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK+AWS_REGION and CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX+CLOUD_ML_REGION+ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID [CLM-686][CLM-687]; please align narration and *.env.example. G3 please measure the 0:20 cut (dashboard from complete state); spec assumes ~90 s.
